build.command: git ls-files 'src/*.ts' 'adapters/*.ts' 'bin/*.ts' | while read f; do bun build "$f" --target=bun --outfile=/dev/null >/dev/null || exit 1; done

unlabelled_fixtures.command: for f in test/fixtures/*.jsonl; do n=$(basename $f .jsonl); grep -q "$n" test/calibrate.ts || echo "UNLABELLED $n"; done

missing_docs.command: grep -oh 'docs/[a-z/-]*\.txt' llms.txt README.md | sort -u | while read d; do [ -f "$d" ] || echo "MISSING $d"; done

unfitted_specs.command: bun -e 'import {loadSpecFile} from "./src/session.ts"; import {evaluate,validateSpecs} from "./src/specs.ts"; const s=loadSpecFile(".").specs; for (const x of s) if (!x.require && !x.fitted) console.log(x.id)'

malformed_requires.command: bun -e 'import {loadSpecFile} from "./src/session.ts"; import {evaluate,validateSpecs} from "./src/specs.ts"; const s=loadSpecFile(".").specs; for (const p of validateSpecs(s)) if (p.problem.startsWith("require")) console.log("MALFORMED", p.id)'

spec_crashes.command: bun -e 'import {loadSpecFile} from "./src/session.ts"; import {evaluate,validateSpecs} from "./src/specs.ts"; const s=loadSpecFile(".").specs; for (const p of validateSpecs(s)) console.log("CRASH", p.id, p.problem); for (const x of s) if (x.require) try { evaluate(x.require, {}) } catch (e) { console.log("CRASH", x.id, e.message) }'
